body:
My note from near midnight: the field trial crew carried rinsed gloves. my brother started coughing. I had not yet heard that a patrol turned everyone back.

I folded the corner so I could find the entry again. Someone wanted the book put away before I had even finished copying it.

The next morning I looked for a second copy and found only the envelope. I left this one unfolded for whoever came after us.
title: Near midnight: rinsed gloves
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.
